name: argus
description: An autonomous AI back office that guards a PayPal merchant account: risk, disputes and billing agents with a human approval queue.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
